new.analysis:
## What I read from the week

You wrote that you felt great going in, then no runs landed on Mon, Wed or Sat. That is a full miss against the planned three walk-runs, and I would like to know what got in the way — illness, work, weather, motivation, something else — so I can plan around it rather than guess.

## Why this plan

I am resetting to the week you ran well on Sep 14 – 20, not stepping forward. You were fit enough then to do 8 x 2 min run / 1 min walk twice and 9 x 2 min run / 1 min walk on the weekend, with heart rate and effort both sitting fine. Repeating that proves the base is still there before we add anything new.

## Race context

Running the whole 5K means stretching the run intervals until they join up, which usually takes four to six weeks of steady work. We have about seven weeks, so one missed week is survivable but two in a row would start to pinch the goal. If next week lands cleanly I will lengthen the run intervals the week after — think 3 min run / 1 min walk — and we stay on track.

## One ask

Please jot a line in next week's check-in about what blocked the runs, even if it is just "life got busy". It changes whether I plan around a bug, a schedule crunch, or something else, and it is the fastest way for me to help.
